Title: BT Redirect Manager
Description: Modern URL redirect manager for Umbraco 13, 17, and 18. Manage 301, 302, 404, and 410 redirects from a clean backoffice dashboard with regex support, CSV import/export, and a built‑in test tool.

Screenshots.Caption: Dashboard – BT Redirect Manager overview with status code legend, filters, and redirect list.
Add New Redirect – clean modal with status code, Old/New URL, notes, Active and Regex match toggles.
Edit Redirect – update existing rules with the same modern form and toggles.
